create_RenderLightfield: create a RenderLightfield instance with a model, subdivision, and config for lightfield rendering
run_render_chunked: run render_chunked to process rays in batches using a render function and chunk size
run_RenderLightfield_forward: run the RenderLightfield forward method to render rays through the lightfield model
run_RenderLightfield_embed: run the RenderLightfield embed method to get embeddings for rays through the model
review_Render_run_chunked: review the Render base class _run_chunked method for chunked inference with configurable net_chunk size
